title: Agent Core Module
summary: This module defines the core architecture for AI agents, including their execution flow, interaction with language models, output handling, and configuration. It provides the foundational components for building and running intelligent agents.

nodes.label: Abstract Agent Interface
nodes.title: AbstractAgent
nodes.description: The foundational abstract class that outlines the common properties and methods for all agent implementations, including execution and configuration.

nodes.label: Extend Agent Functionality
nodes.title: WrapperAgent
nodes.description: A base class for creating agents that extend or modify the behavior of another agent by wrapping its core functionalities.

nodes.label: Agent Configuration Specification
nodes.title: AgentSpec
nodes.description: A Pydantic model for defining agent configurations using declarative YAML or JSON specifications, enabling easy deployment and sharing.

nodes.label: Process User Prompt & Instructions
nodes.title: UserPromptNode
nodes.description: Initializes the agent's state with the user's prompt and system instructions, preparing for the first model interaction or tool execution.

nodes.label: Request Model Response
nodes.title: ModelRequestNode
nodes.description: Sends the current message history to the language model, handles streaming responses, applies capability hooks, and manages retries for model interactions.

nodes.label: Execute Tool Calls
nodes.title: CallToolsNode Logic
nodes.description: Processes tool calls suggested by the model, executes them via the Tool Manager, and integrates their results back into the conversation history. (Logic from handle_call_or_result and _call_tool)

nodes.label: Define Agent Output Schema
nodes.title: OutputSchema
nodes.description: Specifies the expected data structure and validation rules for the agent's final output, supporting text, structured data, and image types.

nodes.label: Manage Structured Outputs
nodes.title: OutputToolset
nodes.description: Organizes and provides definitions for structured output types that the agent can produce, treating them as callable tools for the model.

nodes.label: Validate Agent Output
nodes.title: OutputValidator
nodes.description: Applies custom validation logic to the agent's output, ensuring it conforms to defined rules before being returned.

nodes.label: Describe Function/Tool Signatures
nodes.title: FunctionSignature
nodes.description: Captures and renders the structural details of function signatures, including parameters and return types, for tool definitions and schema generation.

nodes.label: Stream Agent Execution & Results
nodes.title: AgentStream
nodes.description: Provides an interface for asynchronously streaming events, partial outputs, and the final result from an agent's execution, including usage tracking.

nodes.label: Capture Run Message History
nodes.title: capture_run_messages
nodes.description: A context manager that provides access to the ModelMessage history exchanged during an agent's run, useful for debugging or error handling.

nodes.label: Synchronous Model Request
nodes.title: model_request_sync
nodes.description: Provides a blocking, non-streaming interface for making direct requests to language models, useful for simple, immediate interactions.

nodes.label: Synchronous Streamed Model Request
nodes.title: model_request_stream_sync
nodes.description: Offers a blocking, streaming interface for direct model requests, allowing synchronous iteration over streamed model responses.

nodes.label: LLM Model
nodes.title: models_and_embeddings
nodes.description: Represents the underlying large language model used by the agent for generating responses and making decisions.

nodes.label: Tool Manager
nodes.title: tools_and_capabilities
nodes.description: Handles the registration, discovery, and execution of tools and capabilities available to the agent.

nodes.label: Agent Capabilities
nodes.title: tools_and_capabilities
nodes.description: Provides extensible functionalities and hooks that modify or enhance agent behavior during execution.

nodes.label: Graph Run Context
nodes.title: graph_engine
nodes.description: Provides the execution context and state for the agent's internal graph, managing dependencies and message history.

nodes.label: Agent Message Types
nodes.title: pydantic_ai_slim.pydantic_ai._messages
nodes.description: Defines the various message types used in agent conversations, such as user prompts, model responses, and tool calls.

nodes.label: Framework Utilities
nodes.title: ui_and_utilities
nodes.description: Provides common utility functions for asynchronous operations, event loops, and general helpers used across the framework.

groups.label: Agent Definition & Configuration
groups.title: Agent Definition & Configuration
groups.description: Components defining the core agent interface, its configuration via specifications, and mechanisms for wrapping existing agents to extend functionality.

groups.label: Agent Execution Flow
groups.title: Agent Execution Flow
groups.description: The sequential nodes that drive the agent's interaction loop, from processing user input to requesting model responses and executing tools.

groups.label: Output & Schema Management
groups.title: Output & Schema Management
groups.description: Components responsible for defining, validating, and processing the structured and unstructured outputs generated by the agent and its tools.

groups.label: Data Flow & Streaming
groups.title: Data Flow & Streaming
groups.description: Handles the real-time streaming of agent results and events, as well as capturing the message history for introspection and providing direct model interaction utilities.
